name: lodestar
description: Lodestar, a top-down pixel-art mining and looting game for the phone browser, in plain JavaScript. The game itself needs nothing installed: these are the test tools only.

scripts.test: sh test/check.sh && node test/gen.js && node test/traces.js && node test/fights.js && node test/gllight.js && node test/pwa.js && node test/smoke.js
